# Architecture Overview

*Generated by /shipwithai-starter on 2026-05-26. Edit directly.*

---

## System overview

**spring-saas-support-ai** is a full-stack monorepo (Spring Boot API + minimal React admin + vanilla JS widget) built with Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.3.

Architecture style: **Modular monolith** — domain packages with internal slice architecture (`Controller → Service → Repository → Entity`).

Primary goal: portfolio/job hunting demo for Senior Java + AI Integration roles. Secondary: SaaS monetization.

---

## Key layers

| Layer | Directory | Responsibility |
|-------|-----------|----------------|
| Controllers | `src/main/java/…/*/` (per package) | REST endpoints, request/response mapping, input validation |
| Services | `src/main/java/…/*/` (per package) | Business logic, tenant-aware operations, quota checks |
| Repositories | `src/main/java/…/*/` (per package) | JPA repositories — Hibernate tenant filter auto-applies |
| Entities | `src/main/java/…/*/` (per package) | JPA entities, all business entities extend `TenantEntity` |
| Common | `src/main/java/…/common/` | `ApiResponse<T>`, `TenantEntity`, `GlobalExceptionHandler` |
| Config | `src/main/java/…/config/` | Security, AsyncConfig, OpenAPI, CORS |

---

## Entry points

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/main/java/com/leonardtrinh/supportsaas/SupportSaasApplication.java` | Spring Boot main class — starts HTTP server |
| `src/main/resources/application.yml` | App config (profiles: dev, test, prod) |
| `src/main/resources/db/migration/` | Flyway migrations — applied in version order on startup |

## Package structure

```
com.leonardtrinh.supportsaas
├── auth/              # JWT signup/login/refresh, JwtAuthFilter (sets TenantContext)
├── tenant/            # TenantContext (ThreadLocal), Hibernate filter, Business entity
├── member/            # Member entity, role management
├── invitation/        # Member invitation flow + accept endpoint
├── knowledgebase/     # KB CRUD
├── document/          # Document upload + RAG pipeline
│   ├── ingestion/     # Async parse → chunk → embed pipeline
│   ├── chunk/         # Paragraph-aware chunking, max 1000 tokens
│   └── search/        # Hybrid vector (PgVector) + full-text (PG tsvector) + RRF
├── chatbot/           # Chatbot settings, widget configuration
├── chat/              # Streaming SSE, conversation + message storage
├── billing/           # Stripe subscriptions, plan tiers, UsageRecord
├── storage/           # MinIO document upload/download
├── email/             # Resend transactional email
├── audit/             # Audit log for sensitive operations
├── admin/             # Super-admin endpoints (bypasses tenant filter with explicit disable)
├── common/            # ApiResponse, TenantEntity, GlobalExceptionHandler, ProblemDetail
└── config/            # SecurityConfig, AsyncConfig, OpenAPI, CORS
```

## External dependencies

| Service | Purpose | Env var |
|---------|---------|---------|
| PostgreSQL 16 | Primary database, all business data | `SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL` |
| PgVector | Vector similarity search (cosine) for RAG | Same DB, extension enabled |
| Flyway | Schema migrations, auto-runs on startup | — |
| Anthropic Claude | Chat completions for support chatbot | `SPRING_AI_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` |
| OpenAI | `text-embedding-3-small` for document chunks | `SPRING_AI_OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| Stripe | Subscription billing, plan enforcement | `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` |
| Resend | Transactional email (invitations, resets) | `RESEND_API_KEY` |
| MinIO | Object storage for uploaded documents | `MINIO_ENDPOINT` |
| Docker Compose | Local dev: Postgres + MinIO + Mailhog | `docker-compose up -d` |

---

## Multi-tenancy

Row-level isolation — shared DB, shared schema. Every business table has `business_id UUID`.

```
HTTP Request
  → JwtAuthFilter        sets TenantContext.setTenantId(tenantId)
  → Controller
  → Service
  → Repository.findAll() ← Hibernate filter auto-appends WHERE business_id = :tenantId
  → Response
  → JwtAuthFilter finally TenantContext.clear()   ← NEVER skip
```

Async threads: `@Async("taskExecutor")` via `AsyncConfig` — uses `TenantContextCopyingDecorator` to propagate tenantId to worker threads.

---

## RAG pipeline (document package)

```
Upload → MinIO storage
  → [Async] Parse text (PDF/DOCX/TXT)
  → Paragraph-aware chunk (max 1000 tokens, 100-token overlap)
  → OpenAI text-embedding-3-small → store in PgVector
  → Full-text index update (tsvector)

Query →
  Top-10 by cosine similarity (PgVector)
  + PG full-text search
  → Reciprocal Rank Fusion → Top-5 chunks
  → Claude prompt context → streaming SSE response
```

---

## Async processing

`@Async("taskExecutor")` — `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor` (core=4, max=16, queue=100) with `TenantContextCopyingDecorator`.

**Async:** document ingestion, email sending, webhook delivery, audit log writing.
**Sync:** API responses, streaming SSE chat, auth operations.

## What to know before touching code

**Do not edit manually:**
- `target/` — Maven build output
- `.env` — secrets, never commit
- `src/main/resources/db/migration/V*.sql` — applied Flyway migrations; only add new files, never modify existing

**Test isolation requires:**
- `docker-compose up -d` before integration tests
- `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=test`
- Some tests need seed data — check `src/test/resources/`
- Naming: `{Name}Test` (unit), `{Name}IT` (integration)

**Sensitive areas (security review before merge):**
- `auth/` — JWT filter chain, token issuance
- `tenant/` — TenantContext ThreadLocal, Hibernate filter; `TenantContext.clear()` MUST be in `finally`
- `document/ingestion/` — async pipeline; MUST use `@Async("taskExecutor")`
- `admin/` — only class allowed to call `session.disableFilter("tenantFilter")`

---

## Key architectural decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Multi-tenancy model | Row-level isolation | Cost-effective for MVP; standard for this scale |
| Async framework | Spring `@Async` + ThreadPoolTaskExecutor | No Kafka/RabbitMQ needed at this scale |
| Vector store | PgVector (same DB) | Avoids extra infra; sufficient for MVP |
| Auth library | JJWT (HS256) | Simpler than RS256 for single-service MVP |
| ORM | Spring Data JPA + Hibernate | Tenant filter via Hibernate `@Filter` |
| No virtual threads | `spring.threads.virtual.enabled=false` | Virtual threads break ThreadLocal scoping for TenantContext |
